notes: Reached via Chrome connector only (own tab), EN storefront www.bloomingville.com/en/products; every request HTTP 200, no WAF/403/CAPTCHA at any point. robots.txt names no Claude agent (only Disallow /Files/Papirkurv/ and *?cartcmd=*). sitemap.xml is useless here - it contains 2 redirect URLs and no category URLs. TREE: taken as the union of (a) the Furniture department page's own tile strip (14 nodes), (b) the sitewide flat 'Shop by category' menu at /en/products/category (112 nodes, which added furniture/cabinets, furniture/racks and furniture/stools that the department page does NOT link), and (c) the Outdoor / Kids (Bloomingville MINI) / Living room / Office department pages. Breadcrumb JSON-LD on every node confirms a FLAT taxonomy - every furniture node's breadcrumb is 'Frontpage > Products > Furniture > X', so parentage had to be established by product-ID containment rather than by URL depth. COUNTS: the site publishes no rendered 'N products' header. Each listing is server-rendered with an e-productlist widget exposing data-page-size (always 12), data-page-count and one data-product-id per tile. qty = count of UNIQUE data-product-id values after paginating ?PageNum=1..data-page-count, and every row passed the exhaustion check ceil(unique/12)==data-page-count. Same method the prior Home-Decor pass validated on this site. ROLL-UPS RESOLVED BY ID OVERLAP (not by name): 'Chairs' (43) is a roll-up - it contains 13/13 of Dining chairs and 19/19 of Lounge chairs, plus 10 Bloomingville MINI kids chairs and 1 bar chair; emitted as a grouping row with its two children. 'Tables' (84) is a roll-up - it contains 16/16 Coffee tables, 7/7 Dining tables and 42/42 Side tables, plus 15 of the 44 Cabinets & consoles, 4 kids tables and 1 bar table; emitted as a grouping row with its three fully-contained children. Cabinets & consoles is NOT contained in Tables (15/44) so it is emitted as its own leaf. DROPPED AS A STRICT SUBSET: /furniture/stools (7) - all 7 IDs are inside /furniture/poufs-stools (29); the parent is emitted as the leaf because no sibling node covers its other 22 poufs, and emitting both would double-count. OVERLAP DISCLOSED: Children's Furniture (91) shares 15 IDs with Shelves and 10 with Chairs - this catalogue's taxonomy is deliberately non-tree-shaped, so a product can sit in a product-type node and in the MINI kids node at once. Chairs is a grouping row so the 10 do not double-count; the 15 kids shelves do appear in both Shelves and Children's Furniture. VERIFIED NOT FURNITURE, EXCLUDED: /kids/nursery (1 product, title-read = Agnes Play Mat, cotton); /category/storage (no product widget at all - a hub page; its rendered tiles are boxes w/lid, storage boxes, magazine holders, baskets = standalone storage goods); /home-office/magazine-holders (accessories); /furniture/know-your-fabrics (informational page, not a listing). Also excluded per brief: all lighting, mirrors, textiles, tableware, kitchen, bath, Christmas, artificial flowers, hooks & coat racks, and every 'All for the X' / news / sale / offers / series roll-up. SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per node (5 to 91, no constant), no round display caps, every leaf's h1 and breadcrumb match the slug requested, ?PageNum=N returns genuinely different product IDs on every page. No login wall was hit - this is a wholesale-style catalogue that shows RRP prices and full counts publicly, so no node is login-walled.
